pt.titulo: Indonesia threatens prison time for unauthorized downloads of forest data
pt.resumo_biocultura: Indonesia’s government is imposing new restrictions on access to geospatial data, raising concerns among researchers and activists that it will suppress environmental science and advocacy work in one of the world’s most biodiverse countries.
